segments.sn3.17:1.3: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho rājā pasenadi kosalo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn3.17:1.4: “atthi nu kho, bhante, eko dhammo yo ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati –
segments.sn3.17:2.1: “Atthi kho, mahārāja, eko dhammo yo ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati –
segments.sn3.17:3.1: “Katamo pana, bhante, eko dhammo, yo ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati –
segments.sn3.17:4.1: “Appamādo kho, mahārāja, eko dhammo, yo ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati –
segments.sn3.17:4.3: Seyyathāpi, mahārāja, yāni kānici jaṅgalānaṃ [jaṅgamānaṃ (sī. pī.)] pāṇānaṃ padajātāni, sabbāni tāni hatthipade samodhānaṃ gacchanti, hatthipadaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati – yadidaṃ mahantattena;
segments.sn3.17:4.4: evameva kho, mahārāja, appamādo eko dhammo, yo ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati –

lines: Evameva khoti hatthipadaṃ viya hi kārāpakaappamādo, sesapadajātāni viya avasesā catubhūmakā kusaladhammā.
Te hatthipade sesapadāni viya appamāde samodhānaṃ gacchanti, appamādassa anto parivattanti.
Yathā ca hatthipadaṃ sesapadānaṃ aggaṃ seṭṭhaṃ, evaṃ appamādo sesadhammānanti dasseti.
Mahaggatalokuttaradhammānampi hesa paṭilābhakaṭṭhena lokiyopi samāno aggova hoti.
Appamādaṃ pasaṃsantīti “etāni āyuādīni patthayantena appamādova kātabbo”ti appamādameva pasaṃsanti.
Yasmā vā puññakiriyāsu paṇḍitā appamādaṃ pasaṃsanti, tasmā āyuādīni patthayantena appamādova kātabboti attho.
Samadhiggayhāti sammā ativiya gahetvā, ñāyena visesato gaṇhitvā.

after.title: Appamādasuttavaṇṇanā
lines: Appamādassa pāsaṃsabhāve ekantato kattabbatāya pana “etānī”tiādinā kāraṇaṃ āha.
Yasmā paṇḍitā appamādaṃ pasaṃsanti, yasmā ca puññakiriyāsu appamatto ubho atthe adhiggaṇhāti, tasmā āyuādīni patthayantena appamādova kātabboti.
